questions.question: Can a C++ microkernel match Python for stack resolution, including countering a spell below the top of the stack?
questions.why: Stack resolution is the next stable transition family after cast/apply microcases.

questions.question: Can C++ match Python for private and public choice continuations such as Jace +2, Brainstorm, cleanup discard, and Overlord discard?
questions.why: Choice continuations are where hidden information and action masks meet.

questions.question: When do lower-confidence-bound standings and meta-rank stationary mass disagree?
questions.why: Disagreement may reveal cycles, specialist decks, or smoke-table noise.

questions.question: Does meta-rank mass shift between 20-life and 40-life scopes more than raw score standings do?
questions.why: The life dial should be measured as a construction/context axis, not assumed important.

questions.question: How much transition coverage is enough before attempting a C++ random-rollout kernel?
questions.why: A fast wrong rollout engine would poison every learning method.

questions.question: Can sequential racing use meta-rank mass rather than mean score as its pruning criterion?
questions.why: Population mass may preserve specialists that mean-score pruning drops.

questions.question: Does the stall adversary receive meta-rank mass if truncation rows are allowed, and does the promotion gate suppress it?
questions.why: This directly tests reward-hack isolation under a population evaluator.

questions.question: Can a tiny action-feature ranker imitate public/code policies well enough to become a cheap response oracle?
questions.why: This is a safer first neural target than end-to-end RL.

questions.question: Do MAP-Elites deck cells that look mediocre by score gain meta-rank mass through matchup specialization?
questions.why: Quality-diversity only matters if diverse cells have strategic niches.

questions.question: Can audit_cube fail loudly when a Python rules change invalidates a C++ microkernel assumption?
questions.why: Differential C++ only helps if drift is caught immediately.
